Full desktop control

You can fully control your desktop with Gesleap, including the clicks, scrolling, drag n' drop, transmit keystrokes, or close/minimize windows.

Shooter game

Simple augmented reality shooter game, which uses the depth information of the hand to eject bullets.

Touchless piano

Augmented reality piano application with no equipment needed. You can press each key by laying your finger on it for a certain duration.

Version 0.20 demo

Version 0.20, showcasing the available full desktop control functionality and some custom-mase applications using our software as an engine.

Version 0.22 demo

Version 0.22 demo, with major UI improvements, such as the hand being overlaid as a skeleton instead of relying on a window.
